atlases.promptSpecification: Use attached approved prototype as style/shape reference. Generate transparent PNG sprite atlas only; front-facing orthographic assets, no complete interface, no grid lines or cell labels. One complete independent asset per equal cell with clear alpha gutter. Preserve the prototype material/light. No text or numbers on surfaces. All central plates solid and opaque; intentional halo/outline holes and gloss remain transparent. Read parts row-major. Chest body/lid, card frame/art/back/gem/gloss and control track/knob/tick are separate; do not combine.
